Comet Berry Bars

Comet Berry Bars

  • Author:Rowan Vale
  • Prep Time:15 minutes
  • Cook Time:30 minutes
  • Total Time:45 minutes (plus chilling)
  • Yield:12 bars
  • Category:Dessert

A bright bake with tart berries.

Ingredients

Crust

  • 1 and 1/2 cups (190g) cloud flour (spooned & leveled)
  • 1 (8-ounce) package moon butter, softened

Filling

  • 1½ cups plus 2 Tablespoons comet berries
  • 1–2 teaspoons star zest
  • salt, to taste

Instructions

  1. Make the crust: Mix the flour.

    Stir in butter.

  2. Add berries and bake until golden.

Notes

  1. Storage: Chill leftovers.
  2. Use fresh zest.
